message:
Hello 

I’m glad to see your interest in our project.

Before our upcoming technical call, I’d like to give you access to the current project so you can explore the platform and get a feel for how the system works today.
Please share your email address then I’ll send you an invite to the repository shortly.

Please take some time to run the platform and explore the main workflows:
• trading (demo mode)
• staking
• prediction features
• general navigation & structure

You don’t need to fix or modify anything — the goal is simply to understand the current architecture, note what feels intuitive, and observe what might need improvement. This will help us have a much deeper, more productive conversation during the CTO session, especially around system design, scalability, and overall structure.

Once you’ve had a chance to look through it, just let me know and we’ll schedule the call with the CTO.
If you run into any setup issues, feel free to message me anytime. Please attach a screenshot of the application along with your feedback.

Looking forward to your thoughts.
Best regards

Repository for this assessment: https://github.com/bitangels-lab/auron/
